prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: an iron floor grating over a dark shaft, riveted plates around it The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square SEAMLESS TILEABLE game-map ground texture, premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art top-down JRPG: repeated iron floor grating over dark recessed shafts, surrounded/interspersed with worn riveted iron plates. Evenly distributed repeated surface pattern, no single focal feature. Orthographic steep overhead top-down, no convergence. Left edge must continue exactly on right edge; top edge must continue exactly on bottom edge, periodic pattern designed to wrap both axes. Fill canvas edge-to-edge with only this surface; no frame or borders. Crisp consistently sized square pixels, hand-placed pixel clusters of 3–10 pixels and clearly shaped material details; no antialiasing, blur, gradients, soft brushes, photo texture, noise, or checkerboard dithering. Material palettes 4–6 shades each, earthy iron colors, saturated purplish/reddish shadows, warmer yellow-tinted highlights, lived-in weathering. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting, clean base colors: no cast shadows, nighttime, artificial lights, glows, pools of light or vignette. Texture-only square tile for an RPG environment.
